acceptance.output_evidence: (1) WHICH OPERATIONS' CONSUMER FIXTURES DISAGREED WITH II.3, AND HOW EACH WAS DISPOSITIONED. The disagreement is not per-operation, it is TOTAL and it has two independent axes, so both are stated with their denominators. AXIS ONE -- WHAT AN OPERATION IS (row IRPT_BCKEND-W2-S13, OBSERVATION/INERT): the consumer publishes 11 operations as FLAT SLUGS (/api/scoped/investor-reporting/directory-search) and v1 publishes 12 NESTED routes with path parameters (/api/scoped/investor-reporting/directory/search) -- the shape the 14 pre-existing scoped routes on 7k3ed8px20 already use. 11 of 11 consumer paths return ROUTE_UNKNOWN under v1, asserted through the real dispatcher in each paired case. 2 of the consumer's 11 operations have NO producer route at all (submit-correction, export-preview) and 3 of the producer's 12 routes have no consumer operation (GET .../status, GET .../status/{jobId}, GET .../export/{exportId}/download). AXIS TWO -- WHAT A FIELD IS CALLED (row IRPT_BCKEND-W2-S14, OBSERVATION/INERT): censused over every properties object at every depth in the eleven published schemas and every key at every depth in the counterpart's fixture -- the producer publishes 293 distinct property names of which 194 are snake_case and 0 are camelCase; the consumer's fixture carries 220 distinct keys of which 139 are camelCase and 0 are snake_case. The EXACT-NAME overlap is 44 of 293 and ALL 44 are single-word names (access, amount, basis, date, kind) where the two conventions cannot differ. 55 of the 194 snake names match a consumer key ONLY after camelizing -- public_reason_code/publicReasonCode, business_as_of/businessAsOf, scope_fingerprint/scopeFingerprint, directory_revision/directoryRevision among them. DISPOSITION, BOTH AXES, IDENTICAL: THE SCHEMA WAS NOT EDITED. v1 publishes the PRD's II.3 spellings and the PRD's route grammar unchanged; the rows are the notice to the counterpart's round-2 cell, which regenerates against this artifact. No field's meaning, unit or date basis moved to match the frontend, and meaning was not negotiated by casing. || (2) WHAT THE PAIRED TEST CANNOT SHOW ABOUT THE REAL WIRE -- IB-rtb-1's territory, enumerated by SUBTRACTION from the request path rather than by recall: everything between the client and dispatch(). (i) CLOUDFRONT: the behavior's PRECEDENCE among 28 ordered behaviors -- an in-process call never consults an ordered list, so a request that a longer-matching earlier behavior would swallow is indistinguishable here; also caching, which this behavior disables but only the live distribution proves. (ii) THE EDGE VALIDATOR: the paired test SUPPLIES the nine injected headers, so it proves what the dispatcher does GIVEN them and nothing about whether auth-validator-edge actually injects them for a real token -- and firmRole, the claim the Opal-principal question turns on, is injected ZERO times (index.mjs :383-391), which is why the class comes from a server-side roster. (iii) API GATEWAY'S AUTHORIZER RESULT CACHE: naqxlm returns a prior allow for its TTL and that TTL is NOT declared in partners-api/api-gateway.tf (13 authorizer_id references, 0 caching declarations), so a revocation's time-to-effect is unmeasurable in process.
